title: Mother and Toddler, Patio Adirondack Bench - Vintage 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A touching domestic portrait showing a young mother and her toddler son seated together on a white painted wooden Adirondack-style garden bench. The woman wears a classic late 1930s to early 1940s polka-dot dress with puffed short sleeves, paired with white lace-up oxford shoes. The young boy sits beside her dressed in light overalls over a white short-sleeve shirt. Behind them, climbing vines frame a multi-pane sash window and clapboard exterior wall, while a small blurry pet dog dashes into the lower right corner.
